a=np.array(arrs)
print(a.shape)
print('\n'.join(''.join(map(str,row)) for row in a))
# 4-connected 1 components
from collections import deque
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(a.shape[0]):
 for c in range(a.shape[1]):
  if a[r,c]!=1 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cc=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.pop();cc.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    p=(x+dx,y+dy)
    if 0<=p[0]<a.shape[0] and 0<=p[1]<a.shape[1] and a[p]==1 and p not in seen: seen.add(p);q.append(p)
  comps.append(cc)
for comp in comps:
 r0=min(r for r,c in comp);r1=max(r for r,c in comp);c0=min(c for r,c in comp);c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
 print(len(comp),(r0,r1,c0,c1),[''.join('1' if (r,c) in comp else '.' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1)])
